scope: Original kit-specific Stat Focus A/B desk research. Each entry compares an existing source-linked community starting choice with an alternative at equal resources; no gameplay measurements, rights clearance or best-in-slot claim.

statFocusRecommendation.attackReason: For Crossbones, a Critical Rating trial changes eligible would-be critical event frequency; it must not be assumed to increase noncritical debuff tick damage. Keep the source-linked setup constant: Dash back and hold block to enter Overrun, refreshing personal Furies and gaining more. Compare Critical Damage Rating against the same opponent, rank and resources. Crossbones cannot actually land Critical Hits: each would-be critical instead grants Fury. Count Fury applications and timing, not critical-hit damage.
statFocusRecommendation.defenseReason: For Crossbones on defense, Armor Penetration may improve the defender's outgoing direct hits against armored attackers; it does not reduce incoming damage, so a mitigation choice is a real alternative. Kit limitation: Nullify and Stagger can dismantle the ramp. Ability-accuracy protections can defeat suppression. Compare Block Proficiency using the same attack type, defensive sequence, relic state and node; no across-mode ranking or gameplay result is claimed.
statFocusRecommendation.note: Original dated kit-aware editorial comparison; based on the cited champion rotation and Kabam Stat Focus design, not independent combat tests. Existing community setting remains a hypothesis; Critical Rating versus Critical Damage Rating and Armor Penetration versus Block Proficiency are falsifiable alternatives.

statFocusRecommendation.attackReason: For Cull Obsidian, Physical Resistance can reduce eligible incoming physical damage during a long ramp but does not itself increase damage dealt. Keep the source-linked setup constant: Complete knockout and combo missions to develop persistent charges. Compare Block Proficiency against the same opponent, rank and resources. This proposed offensive Physical Resistance focus supports longer mission/ramp survival, not a higher Rout damage number.
statFocusRecommendation.defenseReason: For Cull Obsidian on defense, Armor Penetration may improve the defender's outgoing direct hits against armored attackers; it does not reduce incoming damage, so a mitigation choice is a real alternative. Kit limitation: Losing Favor buffs reduces damage and utility; sustained blocking needs care. Compare Block Proficiency using the same attack type, defensive sequence, relic state and node; no across-mode ranking or gameplay result is claimed.

statFocusRecommendation.attackReason: For Deadpool (X-Force), Block Proficiency is a survival experiment for the blocking required by the setup, not a direct offensive damage multiplier. Keep the source-linked setup constant: Build charges by walking forward and using the first and third light hits. Compare Physical Resistance against the same opponent, rank and resources. Block Proficiency is a setup-survival choice and should not be presented as a larger Daunted Bleed detonation.
statFocusRecommendation.defenseReason: For Deadpool (X-Force) on defense, Armor Rating reduces eligible incoming damage without creating an Armor Up buff or blocking Armor Break. Kit limitation: Bleed immunity differs from purification; do not assume it triggers the replacement. Compare Block Proficiency using the same attack type, defensive sequence, relic state and node; no across-mode ranking or gameplay result is claimed.
